users.notes: Self-only profile. Credentials and email remain in Firebase Auth. No role on user profile.

groups.notes: Creation atomically creates approved admin membership. Colors consistent on list and detail.

memberships.notes: Authoritative per-group role. Server creates/approves; no self escalation. No private email or survey answers.

invitations.notes: Server validates token and returns only name, description, member count for preview. Rate limit lookup. Never expose token hash list.

fields.title: string
fields.startedAt: timestamp or null, set by startActivity (closed+published -> active)
fields.endedAt: timestamp or null, set by endActivity (active -> ended)
fields.endedVersion: integer or null, publishedVersion at endActivity; feedback is linked to this version
fields.feedbackClosedAt: timestamp or null; feedback accepted only while status == ended and this is null. Set by closeFeedback or 7 days after endedAt

activities.notes: No teamCount input required at creation. No matching method or private constraints on this member-readable document.

fields.questionCriteria: map questionId -> role | time | experience | interest (role=single, time/interest=multiple, experience=scale 1..5)
fields.priority: list of criteria plus 'size', most important first; default = enabled criteria order + 'size'
fields.requireCommonTime: boolean, every team shares at least one time option
fields.teamIds: list, server-set at closeRecruitment (count = ceil(participants / targetTeamSize)); never recomputed afterwards
fields.teamCapacities: map teamId -> positive integer or null (no capacity); default ceil(N/K) set once at closeRecruitment
fields.settingsVersion: integer, server-maintained; bumped on every settings change

activitySettings.notes: Admin-only read. Placement preferences are NOT copied here. Engine fields are written by createActivity/updateMatchingSettings/closeRecruitment on the server.

activityQuestions.notes: Displayed only after apply action. Locked after first accepted response; cancellation does not unlock questions.

registrations.notes: Submit/edit/cancel through server transaction checking membership, deadline, status and capacity; retries must not increment count twice. Draft form is not a registration.

fields.teams: list of team id and member UID list
fields.validation: non-sensitive map {valid, conflicts, summary: public per-team metrics}
fields.unassigned: list of uid not yet in a team (manual edit)

drafts.notes: Admin only. No preference targets, counts, raw reasons, or revealing errors. Draft changes never mutate publications. One working draft per activity; history in drafts/{activityId}/history/{runId}.

fields.validTo: timestamp or null; set when the next version is published

publications.notes: Server snapshot; only validTo is set later. Admin read only. Members receive their own teamViews instead of the entire roster.

teamViews.notes: Only corresponding participant reads. No matching method, answers or private preference explanations. Update all views and publishedVersion atomically for bounded MVP; version-gate larger publishes.

fields.scores: {overall, schedule, roles, rejoin} each integer 1..5 (questionnaire r1)
fields.membershipRatio: 0..1, time in teamId during [startedAt, endedAt] across publications (server-set)
fields.learningConsent: boolean copy of consents/{uid}.learning.agreed at writing time
fields.commentTags: null | {version: ctag1, status: ok | failed, tags: [{tag, sentiment}], model, modelVersion, taggedAt} (server-set after feedback closes)

feedback.notes: Only author reads raw record. Server checks ended activity and participant. Admin reads aggregate from activities/{id}/feedbackSummary/current. Written by submitFeedback; editable until feedbackClosedAt. Editing the comment clears commentTags.

placementPreferences.notes: Owner read only; server validates create/revoke. No admin access, even existence/count. Reject self targets; verify shared activity membership.

notifications.notes: Owner read/mark read only. Server writes, idempotent operation IDs.

fields.status: OPTIMAL | FEASIBLE | INFEASIBLE | LIMIT_NO_CANDIDATE | STALE | ERROR

formationRuns.notes: Server-only run log (default-deny). Public fields only; serverRuns/{runId} holds the full snapshot incl. private inputs, never client readable.

fields.teams: map teamId -> {respondents, averages {overall, schedule, roles, rejoin}, tags {tag: {pos, neg, neutral}}}; only teams with >= 3 respondents

feedbackSummary.notes: Admin read only. No individual rows, user IDs or comment text.

consents.notes: Owner read only; written by setLearningConsent. Kept out of users/{uid} because its rules allow only displayName/createdAt/updatedAt.

rateLimits.notes: Server-only (default deny). Invitation code checks: 20 per 10 minutes per user.
